openWork: Точные серийные границы отдельных модернизаций продолжают уточняться в source/variant layer и не блокируют Stage 3.
Изображения, координаты на листах компоновки и мелкие аппараты добавляются как расширение, не меняя существующие ER-EQ-ID.
Для БЛОК подтверждено применение на 2ЭС5К; серийные границы и применение на 3ЭС5К требуют отдельного первичного документа.
Параметры, зависящие от профиля, не универсализируются.

rules: all sourceRefs use registered sourceIds and locators
every record has explicit parameterCoverage and relationCoverage
JSON and CSV share the same 111 entity IDs
variant-specific values are not silently generalized

knowledge.note: Stage 4 закрыт: системные, аппаратные, режимные и концептуальные статьи связаны с Stage 3 FINAL v2.0. Наблюдаемые признаки не являются диагностическими действиями; действия остаются Stage 5.

scope.description: Interactive variant-aware diagnosis and emergency routing for 2ЭС5К/3ЭС5К. It localizes symptoms and links sources; it does not expand personnel authorization.
scope.mainCatalogRule: Only distinguishable user-facing situations are shown in the main list. Granular equipment triage cards remain reachable from equipment/knowledge/trainer.
scope.safetyRule: No protection bypasses, jumpers, forced HV operations or repair-only actions are emitted as generic user steps.

integrationContract.catalogPattern: validated main scenarios + granular symptom/equipment cards, mirroring the existing DiagnosticCatalogRepository composition model

principles: No universal Ermak scheme: every representation is gated by model/profile/section where relevant.
Scheme designation is presentation metadata; ER-EQ-ID remains equipment identity.
Original source locator and applicability stay attached to each scheme.
Hotspots link to equipment, knowledge and diagnostics by stable IDs.
Functional overlays never invent undocumented wiring or pneumatic internals.

variantSelector.rule: Variant selection happens before detailed scheme rendering. Unknown dimensions do not silently default to another execution.
hardRules: brake variants 395 / 130 / 130-2 are mutually exclusive for one selected execution
motor-axle bearing plain / rolling are separate scheme profiles
BLOK scheme is not generalized to all 2ES5K or to 3ES5K
MSUD-015/axle-control overlays do not replace the base wiring diagram unless a full primary late-execution scheme is available
serial-number auto-selection stays disabled where exact production boundary is unresolved

uiContract.referenceImplementation: Current VL80S InteractiveSchematics.kt functional diagram UX
features: variant selector before incompatible scheme variants
one-tap links to knowledge and diagnostic scenarios
step-by-step flow overlay for supported operating modes
hide or lock incompatible schemes instead of showing wrong content
preserve canonical graph separately from UI projection

adapter.details: equipment + KB + diagnostics, not duplicated free text
